content.text: {"id": "mm7013a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 5,110 total participants, a total of 2,294 (44.9%) responded that they would receive"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Willingness to receive a vaccination was lowest among Black participants (36.7%)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 5,110 total participants, a total of 2,294 (44.9%) responded that they would receive"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "45% were willing to be vaccinated"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Willingness to receive a COVID-19 vaccination was higher among participants in prisons than among those in jails"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "When stratified by sex and race/ethnicity, willingness to receive a vaccination was highest among Hispanic men (54.9%)"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "A multivariable logistic regression model was constructed"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a survey was conducted in three prisons and 10 small-to-medium–sized jails"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Multivariable logistic regression was used to compare willingness to receive a vaccination"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Willingness to receive a COVID-19 vaccination was compared by incarcerated or detained persons’ sex, age, and race/ethnicity"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "Separate bivariate logistic regression models were constructed"}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "comparing “yes,” “maybe,” and “no” vaccination willingness and race/ethnicity among men (by chi-square test)"}, {"loc": "table 3", "q": "comparing the distribution of reasons between “maybe” and “no” vaccination willingness (by chi-square test)"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
